messages:
Sofia H: Drafting a short POC onramp so AEs can hand off cleanly. Need minimal required fields and owners.
Liam B: Short please. AEs hate long forms.
Maya P: Adding a compact checklist and CLI snippets. This should cover Hosted keys, Dedicated pool requests, and Private/VPC asks.
Maya P: COMPACT CHECKLIST:
1) Create trial project/org in Console (note customer name + deal id)
2) Issue hosted API key scoped to features; default TTL 14d
3) Apply soft quotas: 150k tokens/day, 8 concurrent streams (adjust per deal)
4) Choose infra mode: Hosted-only or Dedicated/Private
5a) Dedicated: open pool request with GPU, replicas, expected seq len, and trial window
5b) Private/VPC: collect vpc cidrs, peering contact, and KMS requirements
6) Run baseline perf tests and attach logs to ticket
7) Attach completed security presales form and DFD to deal
8) Add POC credits line to quote (SalesOps to confirm amount)

Liam B: Hosted key CLI example:
`rwi api-keys create --project poc-theta --scopes generation,embeddings --ttl 14d --note "POC Theta"`

Raj K: Dedicated pool example for infra:
```
# create trial pool
rwi pools create --name poc-theta-pool --gpus a100 --replicas 1 --region us-west-2 --labels poc,trial
rwi pools set-autoscale --name poc-theta-pool --min 1 --max 3
```

InfraBot: Ticket PROV-7391 created (https://issues.internal.redwood/PROV-7391)

Maya P: Baseline perf commands (run after pool ready):
```
# latency smoke: 64 tokens, 4 concurrency
rwi bench --pool poc-theta-pool --model redwood-3b --seq 64 --concurrency 4 > /tmp/poc-theta-latency.log
# throughput check: 512 tokens, 2 concurrency
rwi bench --pool poc-theta-pool --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --concurrency 2 > /tmp/poc-theta-throughput.log
```

Liam B: If 95th pct latency > 250ms for critical flows tag ticket "latency-risk" and propose smaller model or different GPU SKU.
Sofia H: POC credits wording for quotes: "Included: up to 100 GPU-hours of Dedicated runtime during a 14-day POC. Hosted API usage billed per-token beyond included credits." SalesOps please confirm canonical phrasing.
SalesOps: Confirmed. We'll attach the standard credit amount and link to pricing calculator in the ticket.
Raj K: Private install notes: require a bastion for support ops and KMS key ARN. If customer requests HSM, escalate to Security and mark enterprise.
Maya P: SSH jump example for support (include in ticket):
`ssh -J jump@bastion.internal redwood-admin@10.30.40.50`

Sofia H: Fallback policy: if Dedicated pool can't be provisioned within 48h, notify customer and route to Hosted-compatible model. Use this template when notifying:

TEMPLATE TO CUSTOMER:
Hi {CustomerName},
We encountered a provisioning delay for your dedicated pool. As a temporary measure we'll route your traffic to our Hosted inference cluster using a compatible model variant to keep your tests live. This may change tail latency and cost slightly. We expect to restore dedicated capacity within 24-48 hours and will update you as we make progress.
Thanks,
{AE Name}

Raj K: Hints for sizing: A100 for low-latency interactive tests, H100 for throughput-heavy batch. For models >=70B recommend Dedicated only and call out memory footprint in the ticket.
Maya P: Edge cases to call out: SAML SSO required -> collect IdP metadata and attribute mappings before provisioning console access; Data residency/regulatory flags -> escalate to Security and Legal; Customer requests weights -> disallowed for Hosted, escalate for Dedicated/private licensing.
Liam B: Handoff owners (short): create project + hosted key -> @Liam B; dedicated pool request -> @Raj K; VPC peering + firewall checklist -> @Raj K; security questionnaire -> @Sofia H; credits/quote update -> @SalesOps.
Sofia H: Timeline suggestion: kickoff within 24-48h of signed SOW, bench within 48h of pool ready, weekly check-ins with customer during POC.
Maya P: I'll fold this into Confluence under POC runbooks and attach PROV-7391. Reply with any missing pieces by EOD and I'll update.
